title: Nano calcium carbonate promotes phosphorus uptake in wheat by modulating the rate of phosphorus release and facilitating soil bacterial-mediated phosphorus morphological transformation processes
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00811A, Paper
Yu Gao, Shuang Chen, Cexun Ji, Kui Chao, Xiulin Wang, Yan Shi
NCC can reduce leaching losses of P fertilizers by slowly releasing P and increase soil AP content by increasing the abundance of bacteria carrying phoD, gcd, ppx, and ppa genes that activate ALP activity and promote inorganic P solubilization.
